decisions.quote:
The stimulus set was modeled after the study by Parrish et al. (2015, Experiment 2),

     which demonstrated the decoy effect in rhesus macaques (Macaca mulatta).
decisions.reason: Prior adjudication and state files (1737bf0366e698d3.json, 1737bf0366e698d3.state.json) do not yet exist. Although the paper itself is a replication study of Parrish, Evans, and Beran (2015, Attention, Perception & Psychophysics, DOI 10.3758/s13414-015-0885-6, Experiment 2), that sole tested original is already paired to shipped row 377 (target_index 0). Shipped row 554 lists the uncited 2014 conference presentation abstract by Parrish and Beran (DOI 10.1037/e524912015-308, "Rhesus Monkeys Fall for the Decoy Effect in a Perceptual Discrimination Task"), which is an alternate meeting-abstract report not cited or independently tested by this paper. Resolving dependencies with original={"action":"remove_row"} on row 554, row 554 is not a valid replication target row.
